theme_context.global_rules: No generic emojis. No badges/pills (REFUSED by client). High-end typography. Refined spacings and borders.

placeholder_treatment.description: Replaces the raw emoji with a refined, geometric abstract representation of a citadel or a premium gradient texture.
placeholder_treatment.dark_mode: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#081729] to-[#0F2747] flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden h-full w-full
placeholder_treatment.light_mode: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F5F7FA] to-[#E2E8F0] flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden h-full w-full
placeholder_treatment.svg_instructions: Use a minimalist, 1px stroke vector SVG representing a geometric citadel or shield (lucide-react: Castle or Shield icon) instead of an emoji.

motion.hover_card: Smooth lift (-translate-y-1.5) over 500ms ease-out. Soft shadow expansion.
motion.hover_image: Subtle cinematic scale (scale-110) over 700ms ease-out, creating a high-end feel.
motion.hover_border: Color transition on border from near-transparent (white/[0.04]) to gold (#C9A45C/40) over 500ms.

image_urls.description: Dark tech dashboard to be used as sample asset image
Abstract deep blue texture for unknown asset cover in dark mode
Light textured background for light theme samples

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. The client explicitly refused emojis and badges.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
No placeholder text for images. Only use the provided image URLs.
Use subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and micro-animations for hover states.
Use lucide-react icons exclusively when an icon is needed (e.g., for the Eye icon in views, or the Castle icon for the placeholder).
